# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Business workflow mapping and FDE delivery
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Latest Articles
- [상담 통화 내용, 아직 손으로 CRM에 옮겨 적고 계신가요? 상담 통화 요약·기록 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/call-summary-crm-automation/): A practical guide to automating customer call records: collecting disclosed call recordings, converting speech to text, having AI draft structured summaries with inquiry type, requests, mentioned conditions, commitments and next contact date, having the agent review and correct the draft before saving it to the CRM, and turning commitments into follow-up tasks and reminders, with personal data handling and retention agreed in advance.
- [누가 이 숫자를 바꿨는지 아무도 모른다면? 데이터 변경 이력·감사 로그 관리 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/data-change-history-audit-log/): A practical guide to recording who changed key business data such as prices, discount rates, supplier bank accounts and contacts, inventory adjustments, metric definitions and user permissions, when and why, with before and after values, separating human edits from automated jobs, alerting on unusual changes, keeping logs append-only, and using AI only to summarize and search the change history.
- ["그 구매 건 승인 났어요?" 아직 메신저로 물어보고 계신가요? 구매 요청·발주 승인 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/purchase-request-approval-automation/): A practical guide to automating purchase requests and approvals: collecting requests through one form with required fields, routing approvals by amount, item type and budget rules, checking budget balance and duplicate or split requests automatically, using AI only to summarize and classify requests, and sending delay reminders and status updates through to order placement and receipt.
- [우리 품목 수출이 어느 나라에서 늘고 있는지 알고 계신가요? 수출입 무역통계 자동 수집·분석 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/trade-statistics-export-market-data/): A practical guide to automatically collecting public import and export statistics by HS code and country, keeping product code mappings and code revisions consistent, computing year-over-year change, country shares and value-per-weight indicators with fixed formulas, and comparing market trends with your own export results, with AI used only to summarize calculated figures.
- ["그 규정 어디 있어요?" 같은 질문, 아직 사람이 매번 답하고 계신가요? 사내 규정·업무 매뉴얼 AI 질의응답 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/internal-manual-ai-qa/): A practical guide to building an internal Q&A assistant over company policies and work manuals: consolidating the latest documents with owners and revision dates, retrieving only passages the asking employee is permitted to see, having AI answer strictly from those passages with source citations, and routing questions without a documented answer or requiring judgment to the responsible team.
- [같은 '매출'인데 팀마다 숫자가 다르다면? 지표 정의 표준화·자동 집계 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/kpi-metric-definition-standardization/): A practical guide to standardizing business metrics such as revenue, new customers and repeat purchase rate: writing a metric definition sheet with formulas, reference dates, inclusion and exclusion rules and owners, computing all metrics in one shared aggregation layer, and connecting every report and dashboard to the same metric table, with AI used for lookup and explanation rather than calculation.
- [신상품 올릴 때마다 상세 설명을 처음부터 쓰고 계신가요? 상품 등록 정보·상세 설명 AI 자동 작성 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/product-description-ai-automation/): A practical guide to automating product listing content: consolidating product facts into one master record, having AI draft channel-specific product names and descriptions from that data only, checking required fields, length limits and banned phrases with rules, and routing drafts to staff review before publishing.
- [새 매장 자리, 아직 발품과 감으로 고르고 계신가요? 상권·입지 데이터 자동 수집·비교 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/commercial-area-data-store-location/): A practical guide to automatically collecting public commercial-district data such as store listings by business type, resident population statistics and commercial real-estate transaction prices, comparing candidate store locations on the same criteria alongside your own store sales, and monitoring competitor openings and closures around stores after launch.
- [법인카드 영수증, 아직 월말마다 모아서 정리하고 계신가요? 경비 정산 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/expense-receipt-automation/): A practical guide to automating corporate card expense reporting: collecting card transactions automatically, matching receipts captured by employees, having AI suggest purpose and account categories, checking company expense policies with rules, and routing only exceptions to approvers and finance staff.
- [어제 데이터가 안 들어온 걸 아무도 몰랐다면? 데이터 누락·지연 자동 감지 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/data-freshness-missing-data-alert/): A practical guide to automatically detecting missing or delayed daily data loads by checking freshness, row-count ranges, expected units such as stores or channels, and required fields, then alerting owners, flagging incomplete periods in reports, and safely reprocessing.
